introduction: I am passionate about data driven political science studies, specifically in governance, comparative politics and public policy. As a master trainer of SAVE Youth Bangladesh, I work to ensure that all the students in the training get a basic grasp of democracy, human rights, peace, tolerance and diversity.

Lead a team of researcher and data coders to ensure the quality of the data.

experiences.title: Data Coder (November 2025-current)
details: Collecting and coding Data of diplomatic interactions involving Bangladesh of past 25 years
